Hi Andrea — appreciate the quick follow-up and the attachments. We'll start the vendor master creation flow. A few quick items from our side so we don't get blocked during ERP ingest:

1) Can you confirm the remit address for ACH remittance? The email is fine, but our payments team will also need a banking contact and/or a remittance-only postal address if paper checks are used.
2) Please confirm the legal entity exact spelling for our legal team to attach to the vendor record (you listed Stratos Systems, Inc. — any punctuation variations we should be aware of?).
3) For PO acceptance: do you require a PO number on the invoice header? (Yes is fine)

I'll loop Karthik (AP systems) and Marissa (onboarding ops) to keep things moving. We'll provision a vendor ID and send you the vendor portal invitation link where you can upload the W-9 directly if that's easier.

Target timeline: vendor record created and portal invite by Thu, May 7. Let me know if you need a DocuSign for banking forms.

Thanks,
